header.written: The words are French and the pairing is this corpus own. Neither is taken from any release.
header.modified: A reading of at most 4 morae is bound to one noun of at least 1 occurrence per million, no nearer than 0.2 to another anchor and no further than 0.5 from its reading. The readings a character teaches are served before the readings a word teaches.
